name: go9_ownership
hypothesis: Adding auxiliary ownership prediction (KataGo's biggest improvement, ~1.65x) on top of all other improvements should significantly boost training efficiency. Ownership gives 361 bits of learning signal per game vs just 1 bit from win/loss.
success_criteria: Loss < 1.0 by iter 150 AND ownership_loss < 0.5 by iter 100. Compare directly against kitchen_sink (same but without ownership).
notes: Requires latest code (commit 1d26d67+). First experiment with ownership head. use_ownership_head=True in NetworkConfig, collect_ownership=True in self-play. Ownership loss weight=0.02 (KataGo uses 1.5/b² ≈ 0.019).
